added.name: Agency Tool Company
added.long_description:
Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics.

Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets.

Jack Morrison and Davis Foster founded and sold Scythe Robotics after deploying hundreds of autonomous mowers across the country; Agency Tool Company is building the robotics deployment platform across hardware and software they wish they had.
added.one_liner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.

added.long_description:
RonanRX helps you personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, and other treatments using your labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and the latest medical research. Instead of treating the average patient, we continuously personalize your treatment as your body changes.

We've built the complete feedback loop for personalized medicine: your health data automatically syncs into one place, AI helps personalize treatment, licensed doctors make prescribing decisions, medications are delivered to your door, and every outcome continuously improves your protocol.

Connect your health data once. RonanRX automatically syncs your labs, wearables, and medical records into a single AI-powered health profile that helps personalize GLP-1s like Ozempic, peptides, supplements, and other treatments around your biology. If prescribed, your medication is delivered to your door.

Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised over $100M, and previously built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business.

Start with a text at RonanRX.com and become the maximum version of yourself,

long_description.before: We are an AI research lab automating AI research. Our aim is to build a hill-climbing machine capable of solving humanity's greatest challenges in science and engineering, uncovering the next AlphaFold or Transformer faster, more systematically, and at scale. We treat discovery not as a matter of luck, but as a combinatorial search problem. Thesis will be the machine behind the defining breakthroughs of the next decade.
long_description.after:
Thesis is an AI research lab automating AI R&D itself.

We are building Darwin, a hill-climbing machine capable of searching vast combinatorial spaces of experiments. By using the outcome of every experiment to optimize the next, Darwin turns machine learning research into a compounding system rather than a sequence of manual attempts.

We are directing this machine toward the grand challenges of biology and materials science. Our mission is to build the machine that discovers the next Transformer, the next AlphaFold, and the breakthroughs that push science and engineering to the absolute frontier.
